votes.motion: approve the minutes of the December 9 Capital Planning Committee meeting
votes.quote: the committee approved the minutes of the tuesday, december 9 cpc meeting as submitted, 5-0.

votes.motion: adjourn the meeting
votes.quote: joanna made a motion to adjourn the meeting. heather seconded the motion and the committee voted 5-0 to adjourn at 6:36 pm.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the Tuesday, January 6, 2015 CPC meeting as corrected
votes.quote: the committee approved the minutes of the tuesday, january 6 cpc meeting as corrected, 5-0,

votes.motion: Raise the priority of $34,000 for upgraded technology for Town Departments from priority 11 to priority 9
votes.quote: john moved to raise the priority of $34,000 for upgraded technology for town departments from 11 to priority 9. joanna seconded his motion. this would dramatically increase the probability that the upgrade to town technology is funded. the motion was approved 5-0.

votes.motion: Recommend that the Town fund the ten highest priority capital items with a total estimated cost of $1,028,778, and recommend the Town Manager consider borrowing to pay for capital purchases of $100,000 or more (dump truck, backhoe, and street sweeper)
votes.quote: jamie moved that the cpc recommend that the town fund the ten highest priority items with a total estimated cost of $1,028,778, and that the cpc recommend the town manager consider borrowing to pay for one, two or all three of the capital purchases that cost $100,000 or more the dump truck, the backhoe, and the street sweeper. heather seconded his motion and the committee voted 5-0 in favor.

votes.motion: Adjourn the meeting
votes.quote: joanna made a motion to adjourn the meeting. heather seconded the motion and the committee voted 5-0 to adjourn at 6:36 pm.

votes.motion: take funding for painting the Town Hall out of the recommended FY16 Capital Plan
votes.quote: john moved to take funding for painting the town hall out of the recommended fy16 capital plan. heather seconded the motion. the cpc voted 4-0 to approve this motion.

votes.motion: reallocate the $40,000 that had been allocated to paint the Town Hall to fund upgrading the network for the schools and the speed sign for the police department
votes.quote: heather made a motion to reallocate the $40,000 that had been allocated to paint the town hail to fund upgrading the network for the schools and the speed sign for the police department. john seconded the motion and the committee approved the motion 4-0.

votes.motion: apply any unspent monies to the street sweeper and/or dump truck to reduce debt service costs
votes.quote: heather made a motion to apply any unspent monies to the street sweeper and/or dump truck to reduce debt service costs. dennis seconded the motion and the committee voted 4-0 to approve the motion.

votes.motion: approve the minutes of the January 13 meeting
votes.quote: dennis made a motion to approve the minutes of the january 13 meeting. heather seconded his motion and the committee approved the motion 4-0.

votes.motion: adjourn the meeting
votes.quote: john made a motion to adjourn the meeting; heather seconded the motion and the committee approved the motion 4-0.

votes.motion: approve the minutes of the March 31 meeting
votes.quote: heather made a motion to approve the minutes of the march 31 meeting, dennis seconded the motion, and the committee voted 4-0 to approve the minutes.

votes.motion: adjourn the meeting
votes.quote: john made a motion to adjourn the meeting; heather seconded the motion and the committee approved the motion 4-0.

votes.motion: elect Jamie as CPC Chairman for FY 2016

votes.motion: elect Dennis as CPC Vice-Chairman for FY 2016

votes.motion: elect John as CPC Clerk for FY 2016

votes.motion: approve an additional $447 for the radar trailer purchase
votes.quote: john made a motion that the capital planning committee approve that the town spend an additional $447 to make up the difference for the purchase of the radar trailer; heather seconded the motion and the cpc approved the motion 5-0.
